scope.included: non-marriage, non-war-exit character-interaction opportunity discovery, final legality, AI acceptance and outcome verification for the highest-value ordinary-play proposals
excluded: generic religion, faith, doctrine, tenet, fervor, conversion and holy-order behavior
claim that the stock AI scheduler cadence or tie-break is closed
scope.religion_policy: Faith-dependent modifiers encountered inside an otherwise included interaction remain opaque inputs. No generic religion tree is opened.

interactions.opportunity: scripted relations, liege, head of faith, bounded neighboring rulers, peer vassals and vassals; adult quick filter
interactions.acceptance: AI recipient auto-accepts; authored ai_accept base 0 plus the ordinary gold reason and optional struggle modifier
interactions.outcome_postcondition: actor gold decreases by the evaluated gift value and recipient carries gift_opinion toward actor; friendship or other side effects are supplemental

interactions.opportunity: the actor's recruitable guest pool; AI targeting is bounded to guests and final legality checks money, family, ruler and hook conditions
interactions.acceptance: auto-accepted after final validity; selected hook or influence option can replace or alter the ordinary payment path
interactions.outcome_postcondition: recipient is a courtier of actor and the selected gold, influence or hook term is reconciled

interactions.opportunity: no authored ai_targets in this definition; player-side discovery must come from the world/entity frontier and authoritative per-candidate legality
interactions.acceptance: authored ai_accept starts at -50; selected hook can force auto-accept and the other options alter cost or acceptance
interactions.outcome_postcondition: recipient becomes a courtier/guest hosted by actor and the five-year recipient cooldown is present; selected hook, influence or travel-expense payment is reconciled

interactions.opportunity: adult neighboring rulers; actor tier scheduling is disabled for barony/county and every final candidate still passes the full Can Send chain
interactions.acceptance: large authored ai_accept tree; raw recipient score and outer final answer must be read from the finalized exact context rather than reimplemented
interactions.outcome_postcondition: for the first ordinary feudal/clan slice, recipient's immediate liege becomes actor and the selected obligation state matches; Mandala, tributary and religious-exemption branches remain unavailable

interactions.opportunity: hooked characters after perk/struggle availability, adult quick filter, no-war and non-imprisoned validity
interactions.outcome_postcondition: the usable hook is consumed and gold moves from recipient to actor by the authored obligation amount capped at the recipient's available whole gold

interactions.opportunity: multi-role child and guardian selection through populated lists and can_be_picked; final pair still needs full Can Send
interactions.acceptance: auto-accepted with authored ai_accept base 100; option rows can request culture or faith conversion, but faith conversion is excluded from the first action allowlist
interactions.outcome_postcondition: guardian/ward relation exists or an engine-authored travel-to-guardian transition is observably pending; the exact chosen pair must round-trip

interactions.opportunity: multi-role ward/guardian pair with populated-list and pair-validity gates
interactions.acceptance: recipient ai_accept evaluates child jurisdiction, relationships, court, travel and hook inputs; strong hook option can auto-accept
interactions.outcome_postcondition: exact ward and guardian pair gains the relation or a typed travel transition; decline removes temporary offer flags and applies its authored response

interactions.opportunity: multi-role guardian/ward pair with populated-list and pair-validity gates
interactions.acceptance: recipient ai_accept starts at -50 and evaluates hook, liege, parentage, courts and relations; strong hook option can auto-accept
interactions.outcome_postcondition: exact guardian and ward gain the relation or a typed travel transition; over-capacity and decline paths remain distinct outcomes

interactions.opportunity: actor domain title list filtered by can_be_picked_title plus special-interaction gates
interactions.acceptance: auto-accepted after the hard-coded grant-titles special context validates
interactions.outcome_postcondition: every selected title holder becomes recipient and all induced liege/independence changes are re-read; scripted on_accept alone is not the title-transfer authority

interactions.opportunity: actor vassals populated into the secondary-actor slot, then filtered by tier, war, capacity, de-jure and government gates
interactions.acceptance: AI recipient auto-accepts when wants_more_vassals is true; otherwise the ordinary reply lifecycle applies
interactions.outcome_postcondition: the exact transferred vassal's immediate liege equals recipient and the original primary title/holder identity remains consistent

interactions.opportunity: actor prisoners with recipient/payer redirection, then special option and final validity gates
interactions.acceptance: recipient ai_accept depends on payment option, relationship, rivalry and dread; sender ai_will_do is a separate tree
interactions.outcome_postcondition: the exact prisoner is no longer imprisoned by actor and the selected gold/favor/influence/herd/hook exchange is reconciled; unresolved special payload semantics stay unavailable

native_pipeline.definition_identity: stable key hash plus canonical string must round-trip; process-local ordinal is evidence only
send_lifecycle: resolve the exact allowlisted interaction definition from the loaded database
materialize selected target and send-option state
run the complete Can Send validator and mode-1 outer AI answer where applicable
construct and submit CSendCharacterInteractionCommand with player flags 0x0E
wait for a later paused revision and verify the interaction-specific world-state postcondition

P0_candidate_frontier.name: query-core-diplomatic-candidate-frontier-v1
inputs: none; bind to current paused player snapshot
outputs: children, wards and guardian-capable court characters
per-source collection_complete and typed unavailable reason
P0_candidate_frontier.boundary: only generation-safe stable CharacterID rows; no raw pointers and no claim that this reproduces the stock AI's random target sample

P0_proposal_preview.name: query-core-character-interaction-proposals-v1
inputs: bounded stable recipient CharacterIDs discovered in the same snapshot
optional secondary roles/target/options for the role shape
outputs: selected target and canonical option identities
intermediary_raw, recipient_raw and outer_final_status when applicable
P0_proposal_preview.boundary: application-main, paused, double-sampled finalized contexts; unknown special payloads and opaque faith inputs make only the affected row unavailable

P1_generic_action.name: send-core-character-interaction-v1
P1_generic_action.preconditions: fresh paused proposal preview, exact same actor/recipient/options and can_send=true
P1_generic_action.receipt: submission ACK plus later paused revision and interaction-specific world-state postcondition; ACK alone is never success

P2_special_actions.boundary: each role/target/special payload requires its own exact constructor, legality and postcondition proof before entering the allowlist

P1_tributary_extension.name: query-and-send-tributary-proposals-v1
P1_tributary_extension.boundary: consume native final legality and acceptance; faith and Mandala details remain opaque reason rows, while obligation flags and suzerain identities are typed

families: imprison, revoke title, retract vassal and modify vassal contract
P3_deferred_common_families.reason: These remain required for complete play, but coercive risk or typed secret, scheme, contract, prisoner and succession payloads make them later than the first visible proposal loop.

unknowns: the exact stock AI interaction scheduler tick ordering, random target sample, tie-break and final probability draw
a general native target-discovery dispatcher that covers human-visible candidates without opening a GUI
stable numeric send-option flag identifier to canonical string resolution for every included interaction
generic effect-description typed rows and complete outcome preview
special payload constructors and ownership for grant titles, grant vassal and ransom
the final command-execution/postcondition path for any included outbound proposal in a paused production artifact
faith-sensitive modifiers inside offer vassalization and education; these remain opaque by owner policy
tributary obligation payload layout and exact suzerain/top-suzerain native observer ownership
China-government typed career, examination, movement-participant and mentoring-scheme target constructors

regional_followups.reason: China-region realm play requires suzerain and tributary lifecycle decisions; this is not a cosmetic DLC edge.
observer_additions: built-in opinion and variable cooldown state

interactions.postcondition: recipient becomes actor's tributary with the exact authored obligation; decline remains distinct and both response paths carry the authored demand cooldown.
actor is no longer recipient's tributary and authored opinion, legitimacy, prestige and truce consequences are re-read.
actor becomes recipient's tributary under the selected canonical obligation, or an authored current-suzerain intervention becomes observable.
the tributary relation remains and the selected obligation/cost/hook mutations plus recent-reassertion cooldown round-trip.

inbound_only.need: pending inbound semantic decision handler; it is not a player outbound command

regional_followups.reason: Needed before claiming complete China-government play, but typed career, examination, movement and scheme targets make these later than the ordinary proposal loop.
regional_followups.non_diplomatic_sibling_action: The three hidden treasury transfers should expose one typed amount enum {10,50,500} while mapping to the three stock IDs; implementation remains outside DIPLO1.

global_count.behavior: iterates CCharacterInteractionDatabase+0x68 pointer vector with count at +0x74, applies definition/filter gates, constructs redirected context for the requested recipient and counts definitions passing the menu availability chain
global_count.boundary: returns only a count; it is not a row observer and 0x2C41550 is not final Can Send

passive_menu_rows.boundary: menu window locator, lifetime and which of the two GetInteractions array wrappers is bound in the live GUI remain unknown; borrowed pointers cannot cross the snapshot

opportunity_discovery.recommended_first_slice: known allowlisted definition plus bounded recipient preview; do not wait for the global menu row observer
